text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows machines to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being programmed for every task. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. For example, it helps us unlock phones with our faces, suggests movies we might enjoy, and powers voice assistants like Siri. AI also helps doctors find diseases and makes cars safer. As AI grows, it will change how we live and work.
